thread:
Micah: Quick check — staging tenant `echo-bridge` preflight. Network peering and routes are in, but cert provisioning is still pending and the CR for the image-pull-proxy change hasn't been approved. Need owners to confirm any blockers before we start canaries.
Sofia: I can take certs. Waiting on ACME hook to land in the staging CA cluster — ETA ~2h. Will post PR link when ready. :hourglass:
Ananya: Thanks — ping me once cert is up. I need to run the egress prober against the tenant NAT before we flip traffic.
Chris: CR link is here: https://internal.redwood/csrs/CR-8742 — reviewers are listed but needs one more infra approval. @Lia can you take a look? It's a small change to the pull-proxy config.
Lia: On it. Quick skim looks fine, just want to confirm the fallback registry path is correct for air-gapped pulls. I'll approve if that's set to `registry.local/proxy-fallback`.
Micah: Yes that's the fallback. Also note: customer will be airgapped for production, so we need the image sync job to succeed from the mirror. infra-ci-bot last run shows one failing tag.
infra-ci-bot: mirror-sync-job (echo-bridge) — latest run failed on image `redwood/optimizer:sha256:abcd` — error: 401 from mirror registry. See logs: https://ci.redwood/logs/rs-1298
Ananya: I can reach out to the customer registry admin to confirm credentials. If they rotate creds, we need updated secret in k8s `staging/echo-bridge` (namespace). Who owns that secret? @Sofia?
Sofia: Yep that's me. If they update creds I'll roll the `image-pull-secret` and trigger a mirror job manually: `kubectl create secret docker-registry image-pull-secret --from-file=.dockerconfigjson=creds.json -n staging` then `./scripts/mirror-sync --tenant echo-bridge --force`.
Chris: For networking: egress check command I use: `curl -v --resolve api.redwood.test:443:10.20.30.5 https://api.redwood.test/healthz` — this verifies SNI and egress path through the NAT. Ananya, can you run that after certs are in?
Ananya: Will run and paste output. If we see TLS handshake errors, that usually means the peering route lacks the 10.20.0.0/16 prefix. I already opened ticket NET-2431 to add it — currently pending.
Micah: NET-2431 status? We need that before cert validation otherwise canary will flake.
Lia: Network team updated route table this morning; NET-2431 shows "in progress" but should be done in next deploy window (30m). I'll escalate.
Micah: Great. Two quick asks: 1) Lia to approve CR (if fallback is correct). 2) Sofia to update secret when customer provides creds. 3) Ananya to run egress probe after certs. I'll hold canaries until all three are green.
Lia: Approved CR. Left a note about fallback path, confirming it exists.
Sofia: I'll post the secret once customer sends creds. If they don't by EOD we'll use masked test creds and note the caveat.
Ananya: Ran the egress probe after Lia's route change — output: `HTTP/2 200` and TLS handshake OK. Mirror-sync re-run succeeded for the failing tag.
infra-ci-bot: mirror-sync-job (echo-bridge) — rerun succeeded. All images present in staging mirror.
Micah: Awesome. Last item — do we want a brief CR for the rollback play if the onprem registry returns 5xx? Recommend adding a `pullProxy.retryPolicy=3` and a circuit-breaker flag. Chris, can you add a tiny follow-up CR scoped to rollback behavior so ops has a documented path?
Chris: Yep I can add that. I'll create CR-8743 with the options and link here when ready.
Micah: Perfect. If no objections I'll kick canary at 16:30. Standby channels: #eng-oncall and @ops oncall notified. :white_check_mark:
Sofia: Notified the customer about expected window.
Lia: Escalated NET-2431 and updated ticket timeline.
Ananya: Everything green from staging side. Go ahead at 16:30.
Micah: Thanks team — I'll post canary results in this thread and open a short post-check checklist. :rocket:
